---
title: Raw LaTeX tables and inline terms
filters: [html-tex]
terms:
  ara:
    pdf: '\ara{}'
    html: '<span class="ara">Ara</span>'
format:
  html:
    html-tex:
      latex-packages: [booktabs]
      latex-macros: |
        \newcommand{\ara}{\textsc{Ara}}
  pdf:
    pdf-engine: pdflatex
    classoption: twocolumn
    keep-tex: true
    latex-clean: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{booktabs}
        \newcommand{\ara}{\textsc{Ara}}
---

Before **bold ({{< term ara >}})** after.

{{< term ara >}} starts this paragraph.

Table \ref{tbl-regression-native} and Table \ref{tbl-regression-html}.

```{=latex}
\begin{table*}[htbp]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{ll}
\toprule
Term & Value \\
\midrule
\ara{} & 1 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption[Wide table]{Wide table with \ara{}.}
\label{tbl-regression-native}
\end{table*}
```

::: {.keep-content}
Text before the nested table must survive.

```{=latex}
\begin{table*}[htbp]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{ll}
\toprule
Nested & Value \\
\midrule
\ara{} & 3 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption[Nested table]{Nested raw LaTeX table.}
\label{tbl-regression-nested}
\end{table*}
```

Text after the nested table must survive.
:::

```{=latex}
\begin{table}[htbp]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{ll}
\toprule
Name & Value \\
\midrule
Raw & 2 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption[Single-column table]{Single-column raw LaTeX table.}
\label{tbl-regression-html}
\end{table}
```
